newsitem.title: UK: Compass to buy SHRM group for 227 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Compass to buy SHRM group for 227 mln stg.

text.p: British food service management group Compass Group Plc said on Monday it had agreed to buy the French-based SHRM group of companies for 227.1 million stg.
At this stage, Compass is buying 93.32 percent of SHRM but expects to buy the remainder, which is currently held by management, in due course.
As a result of the acquisition Compass has also agreed to sell its 11.17 percent stake in Generale de Restauration to Compagnie Generale des Eaux.
It is also considering refinancing the acquisition-related debt through a convertible bond issue.
Compass said the purchase of SHRM would enhance its earnings in the first full year.

"The excellent strategic fit of SHRM means that the group's position is strengthened in the extremely important French marketplace and also gains entry to other key territories world-wide," said Francis Mackay, deputy chairman and chief executive of Compass.
